reviewMethod: Viewed both actual exported-USDZ Apple SceneKit PNGs using functions.view_image; inspected frozen outline, new raw protocol output, evaluated legacy plan and canonical scene; no generated content was edited.

failures.finding: All four named legs overlap at exactly one physical center.
failures.boundary: The model explicitly chose center for each leg. Available X/Z spreads are positive, so this observation is not zero-spread collapse. The evaluator faithfully emitted zero tangent offsets and did not infer replacements from names or purposes.

failures.finding: Backrest remains through the middle of the seating depth instead of at the rear.
Seating height remains above the approximately 0.45m target.
The reused model outline still includes a separate broad solid base_frame.
failures.interpretation: Visible additional slab under the seat; not a human-authored preset or patched node. Root height and intended frame form remain independent semantic issues.

comparison.interpretation: This one new protocol attempt did not improve the actual chair. It reduced the visible leg positions further. The test does not prove a universal model inability or identify an internal logit cause.

format: GLB zero validator errors/warnings; exact USDZ Apple import and PNG rendering succeeded. None of those counters override this visual failure.
protocolBoundary: New protocol declared and independently reviewed before inference
Frozen Stage1 bytes reused unchanged; no Stage1 rerun
Only one new Stage2 call; no retry, enum reordering, resampling or output repair
Helper selfchecks exercised non-center anchors, actual rotated/freeform AABBs, all eight primitives and translation invariance
Actual response contains only center choices; this record does not claim quality from the helper tests
World-axis AABB positioning does not prove surface contact or general nested scene support
appearanceNote: Fixed-lighting previews again show pale surfaces despite declared brown #5D4037. This does not establish a phone rendering defect.
